tests.name: Database connection
tests.expected: PDO connects using .env settings

tests.name: All required tables exist
tests.expected: 6 tables: users, categories, feedback, replies, login_attempts, activity_logs

tests.name: Unique email constraint
tests.expected: Inserting a duplicate email is rejected by the database

tests.name: Foreign key constraint
tests.expected: Feedback for a non-existent user is rejected

tests.name: Rating CHECK constraint
tests.expected: A rating of 9 is rejected by the database

tests.name: Transaction rollback
tests.expected: Changes inside a rolled-back transaction are not saved

tests.name: Register with valid details
tests.expected: Account created, redirected to login with success message
tests.actual: Redirected to login, success message shown

tests.name: Register with an existing email
tests.expected: "An account with this email already exists"

tests.name: Valid login
tests.expected: User is taken to the dashboard

tests.name: Login with wrong password
tests.expected: "Invalid email or password" shown, no login
tests.actual: Error message displayed, stayed on login page

tests.name: Login with unregistered email
tests.expected: Same generic error as wrong password (no account enumeration)

tests.name: Admin login
tests.expected: Admin is taken to the admin dashboard

tests.name: Logout
tests.expected: Session ends; dashboard then redirects to login
tests.actual: After logout, dashboard redirects to login.php

tests.name: Empty registration fields
tests.expected: Required-field messages displayed
tests.actual: Messages shown for name, email and password

tests.name: Invalid email format
tests.expected: "Enter a valid email address"

tests.name: Weak password
tests.expected: Password rule message; account not created

tests.name: Passwords do not match
tests.expected: "Passwords do not match"

tests.name: Invalid name and phone
tests.expected: Name and phone format errors

tests.name: Feedback rating outside 1-5
tests.expected: Rating error; nothing saved

tests.name: Feedback with tampered category id
tests.expected: Category error; nothing saved

tests.name: Feedback message too short
tests.expected: Length error shown

tests.name: Home page loads
tests.expected: HTTP 200 with statistics

tests.name: Submit valid feedback
tests.expected: Saved and the detail page is shown

tests.name: Feedback appears in "My feedback"
tests.expected: New feedback listed

tests.name: Search and filter
tests.expected: Matching item shown; non-matching hidden
tests.actual: Keyword search correct; rating filter correct

tests.name: Admin replies and resolves feedback
tests.expected: Customer sees the reply and status "Resolved"
tests.actual: Reply visible to customer, status Resolved

tests.name: Update profile
tests.expected: New name saved and shown
tests.actual: Profile updated message and new name shown

tests.name: Change password
tests.expected: Old password stops working, new one works
tests.actual: Changed; login with new password works

tests.name: Admin dashboard, charts and CSV export
tests.expected: Dashboard renders charts; export returns a CSV file

tests.name: SQL injection in login form
tests.expected: Input  ' OR '1'='1' --  does not log in
tests.actual: Login refused; treated as a normal (wrong) email

tests.name: SQL injection in search box
tests.expected: No database error; payload treated as text
tests.actual: HTTP 200, no hashes or SQL errors leaked, zero results

tests.name: Stored XSS in feedback
tests.expected: <script> saved but displayed as harmless text
tests.actual: Output escaped as <script> - script does not run

tests.name: Reflected XSS in search parameter
tests.expected: Search term escaped in the page
tests.actual: Escaped in the search box value

tests.name: CSRF: form submitted without token
tests.expected: Request rejected with HTTP 403

tests.name: CSRF: forged token
tests.expected: Request rejected with HTTP 403

tests.name: Unauthorised admin page (logged in as user)
tests.expected: Access denied (HTTP 403)

tests.name: Protected page without login
tests.expected: Redirected to login page

tests.name: IDOR: opening another user's feedback
tests.expected: Access denied (HTTP 403)
tests.actual: User B got HTTP 403 for User A's feedback #15

tests.name: Passwords stored as hashes
tests.expected: Database holds a bcrypt hash, not the password

tests.name: Role cannot be chosen at registration
tests.expected: Extra field role=admin is ignored; account is "user"

tests.name: Security headers sent
tests.expected: CSP, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy present; no X-Powered-By
tests.actual: All headers present, PHP version hidden

tests.name: Session cookie flags
tests.expected: Cookie is HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax

tests.name: Session fixation prevented
tests.expected: Session ID changes after login
tests.actual: ID before and after login are different

tests.name: Sensitive files blocked from the web
tests.expected: .env, database/schema.sql and logs return 403/404

tests.name: Deactivated account cannot log in
tests.expected: Login refused with "deactivated" message

tests.name: Brute-force lockout
tests.expected: After 5 wrong passwords even the correct one is blocked

tests.name: Security events are logged
tests.expected: Failed logins and denied access appear in activity_logs
tests.actual: 4 of 4 security event types recorded in the last 10 minutes

tests.name: Feedback that does not exist
tests.expected: Friendly 404 page

tests.name: Invalid id value (text instead of number)
tests.expected: Friendly 404 page, no PHP error

tests.name: Array injection in parameters
tests.expected: Handled without PHP errors

tests.name: Delete resolved feedback (business rule)
tests.expected: "Only pending feedback can be deleted"
